objective.primary: Increase breakout probability through first-second clarity, early payoff, average watch time, comments and shares.
objective.note: 70k likes remains a stretch outcome; distribution depends primarily on retention and shares.

benchmark_basis.tiktok: Oct07 synced: 97.4%-98.4% For You exposure but only 3-9s average watch and zero shares/comments. Fix retention and shareability before changing timing.
benchmark_basis.instagram: Oct07 best synced average watch was 7.1s with 43.6% 3s+ view rate; historic winner reached 21.2s and 78.2%.
benchmark_basis.facebook: Oct07 average watch topped at 7s; Oct06 De Pernas pro Ar 2 reached 1,168 views but only ~4s average watch.
benchmark_basis.youtube: Metricool sync remains delayed; internal historic winners favor immediately recognizable Brazilian comedy/conflict.
